scope: Offline ROI128 static-reference candidate; no board, firmware, Flash, canonical-label or split changes
baseline: Frozen previous hub1202 + polar1009 + multi-reference ROI128 annular pose; G21/56 valid, MAE0.15740682142050108psi
admission: One main reference-direction candidate with input, label sources, loss masks, training budget, internal selection and output-evidence rules frozen before its G evaluation
Static registration labels explicitly silver relative-roll evidence, not human pose ground truth or yaw truth; original-image roll is not assumed zero
Unknown reference directions stay ignored; registration failure is not automatically an unreadable-image or no-gauge negative
Runtime uses only128x128U8ROI and declared same-source predicted geometry; no query pressure, GT points, native frame, SIFT or other unavailable inputs
Independent geometric augmentation applies the same coordinate/angle convention to image and reference label; pressure and needle angle cannot supply orientation supervision
Hub and polar remain frozen; any hub replacement requires regenerated same-view polar features and matching provenance
Training/templates/fitted normalization/calibration exclude G and sealed H/ABC; internal held-out groups must not be fitted into training references
Final PSI comparison keeps all56 gauge and3 negative G images, records all computed gate states, and distinguishes first failure from overlapping causes
A changed reference coordinate system may require train-only calibration, but that joint change is not described as a same-calibration pose-only ablation
ProxyHDMI/manual-bbox ROI evidence and actual board gray/automatic localization are identified separately; missing domain equivalence prevents deployment claims but not bounded PC evaluation
stop_or_keep_baseline: Insufficient visible static-print evidence or unreliable silver supervision: state the missing evidence rather than fabricate point coordinates or zero roll
No final PSI benefit after the fixed run: retain previous candidate and do not chase G by changing thresholds or scope
Additional accepted readings with additional large errors: report exact gains/losses and the tradeoff, not unconditional improvement
Unmeasured fixed-point preprocessing, activations, scratch/templates, code, stack, link map or full inference cycles: MCU fit remains pending
Query GT/pressure leakage, mixed-frame geometry, changed canonical/splits or opening sealed H/ABC: fail the affected candidate
final_review: Pending exact candidate and diagnostic artifacts
